decisions.reason: Grounds the containment chain in the session log and env-state, gives the recorded timeline of host death, GUI disconnect and never-recorded tool result, keeps the outcome unknown, and no universal must-crash claim.
Explains shim layer vs package content, dsh/dsh.cmd missing and dsh.ps1 stale, the hand-swapped non-standard tree, and rejects hand-copying directories and hand-writing shims.
Describes the recorded external pinned registry install regenerating shims, dsh --version rc.1 verification, checkout tag alignment, and separates the recorded repair from user-side verification.

Requires R-12-style self-target recognition, refusal to execute in-session, full stop of every dsh process before the pinned external install, restart/refresh/verify, and correctly separates established rules from the new self-host rule; rejects dependent in-host shells.

Proposes a self-target detection guard on the tool layer, uses the zero-card version-only diff to avoid needless re-migration, checks version markers and plugin loading after restart/refresh, and defers backup cleanup until confirmed.

caps.reason: Final protocol explicitly forbids in-session execution and requires a stopped host and external terminal; in-session execution appears only as the rejected past mistake.
Final repair is the formal external pinned install; hand swaps and handmade shims are explicitly rejected.
